title: cafe-llama env schema fragment for merge into ods/.env.schema.json properties

CAFE_LLAMA_ENABLED.description: Explicit opt-in for the experimental cafe-llama runtime; false keeps llama-server as the default.

EXT_CAFE_LLAMA_PORT.description: Host port published for the optional cafe-llama service.

CAFE_LLAMA_MODEL.description: Selected GGUF filename under the ODS model store; supplied by the activation agent.

CAFE_LLAMA_SERVER.description: Path or command name of the cafe-llama.cpp llama-server binary. Empty uses PATH lookup or the extension image binary.

CAFE_LLAMA_EXTRA_ARGS.description: Extra CLI flags for cafe-llama (space-separated), e.g. -hmoe -fa on -ctk turbo4 -ctv turbo4 --spec-type draft-mtp --spec-draft-n-max 4.

LLAMA_ARG_HOST_MOE.description: cafe-llama / advanced llama.cpp: keep MoE expert weights in pinned host memory (-hmoe). Leave unset for stock llama-server.

LLAMA_ARG_N_HOST_MOE.description: cafe-llama: host-MoE for the first N layers only (-nhmoe).

LLAMA_ARG_CPU_MOE.description: cafe-llama / advanced llama.cpp: place MoE experts in system RAM (-cmoe).

LLAMA_ARG_SSD_STREAMING.description: cafe-llama: stream MoE experts from SSD via mmap (-ssd).

LLAMA_ARG_N_SSD.description: cafe-llama: SSD-stream the first N MoE layers only (-nssd).

LLAMA_ARG_PIPELINE_PARALLEL.description: cafe-llama: enable pipeline parallelism when supported.

LLAMA_ARG_NGRAM_SSD.description: cafe-llama: place N-gram tables on SSD.

CAFE_LLAMA_RELEASE_URL.description: Optional release archive URL; required for a CPU-compatible build.

LLAMA_ARG_N_CPU_MOE.description: Optional llama.cpp MoE tuning knob (--n-cpu-moe). Keeps the first N MoE expert layers on CPU/RAM. Leave unset for dense models.

LLAMA_ARG_CACHE_TYPE_K.description: llama.cpp KV cache key type. q8_0 reduces long-context memory pressure versus f16.

LLAMA_ARG_CACHE_TYPE_V.description: llama.cpp KV cache value type. q8_0 reduces long-context memory pressure versus f16.

LLAMA_ARG_FLASH_ATTN.description: llama.cpp Flash Attention mode. Use 'on' for long-context performance tuning when the selected backend supports it.

LLAMA_ARG_SPEC_TYPE.description: Optional per-model llama.cpp speculative decoding mode (--spec-type), normally written by a model runtime profile. Overrides LLAMA_SPEC_TYPE when set. Use only with a llama.cpp build and GGUF that explicitly support the selected mode, e.g. draft-mtp or ngram-mod,draft-mtp.

LLAMA_ARG_SPEC_DRAFT_N_MAX.description: Optional llama.cpp speculative draft token cap (--spec-draft-n-max). For current MTP-capable GGUFs this is commonly tuned by benchmark; leave unset for normal models.
